answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 7150 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I have a property which i wish to get insured against fire and any natural calamity. Please advise if shariyat approves such action. Question: Assaloalikum, I have a property which i wish to get insured against fire and any natural calamity. Please advise if shariyat approves such action. Jaza Kallah kahir! Answer ID: 7150 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1020/901=L/1429) The property insurance involves gambling; therefore it is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
